scope: BWSC2025 complete 5-second logs, 43,963 records; output is a retrospective kinematic replay with observed speed as an exogenous input, not closed-loop MPC.

input_quality.battery_channel_interpretation: Positive Battery_Watt/current is pack discharge; negative is charge. Solar_Watt + Battery_Watt is the integrated HV load proxy used in the team's energy reconciliation.
input_quality.calibration_note: User reports that no calibration adjustment was made. This confirms no post-hoc correction, not traceable absolute sensor accuracy.

selection.selection_rule: Thermal map adopted only if day-blocked MAE improves by at least 2%, fold gamma sign is stable, and no fold is near the imposed bound.

full_training_parameters.optimizer_message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

cv_diagnostics.selection_rule: Thermal map adopted only if day-blocked MAE improves by at least 2%, fold gamma sign is stable, and no fold is near the imposed bound.

limitations: Only 23 moving hourly bins across Days 1-5 are used for fitting.
Open-Meteo weather is a spatial/time model-grid interpolation, not vehicle-mounted irradiance.
No module temperature sensor; Faiman-style cell temperature is a generic roof-mounted prior.
Panel normal/curvature is not surveyed at facet resolution; combined PV+MPPT gain is not intrinsic cell efficiency.

battery.pack_basis: 25S6P user-provided configuration; two-series six-parallel lab discharge curves scaled by 25/2 for pack voltage.
battery.capacity_selection_note: The 10 A curve's integrated 25S6P energy matches the user's 3011 Wh design basis. Prefer its measured 33.164 Ah capacity unless voltage-only LODO improves by more than one logged Main_Volt resolution step (0.1 V); per-day initial SOC and OCV-map error otherwise confound capacity.
battery.map_source_note: 5%-step 25-cell voltage/SoC table from supplied battery materials; treated as empirical reference curve, not certified OCV.
battery.lab_curve_note: 8 A and 10 A discharge-voltage curves are rate-specific; their difference yields only a quasi-static differential-resistance proxy, not pulse-test R0.
battery.state_method: Initialize each separate logged day from its robust first-3-minute 25S voltage/current anchor, then integrate measured battery current by elapsed UTC time. No overnight current is invented.
battery.charge_efficiency_note: Unity coulombic charge efficiency is a transparent placeholder; available source has discharge curves but no charge test. Voltage validation is discharge-road-only.
battery.fit_source: Reused reports/battery_voltage_model_cv.csv generated in this run; refit with the default command when source data or fitting method changes.

soc_resistance_candidate_validation.decision: Do not adopt the SOC-dependent map for the full-race model yet: it improves clean Days 1-5 but fails the anomalous Day 6 holdout. Keep it as the next candidate; the fitted voltage offset is also not adopted because it is not stable and is not a sensor calibration.

limitations: Voltage-SOC table is an empirical reference, not a certified open-circuit curve.
Pack resistance is an effective on-car voltage-current coefficient; it includes wiring, polarization, temperature and aging.
No true in-car SOC measurement, pack temperature measurement, pulse resistance test or charge curve.
Day 3 startup voltage contains a 79.7 V sample followed by a rapid recovery to about 89.6 V; zero/malformed voltage samples are excluded from voltage scoring.

short_horizon_inertial_candidate.decision: tested but not adopted: the small minute-MAE gain does not resolve large residuals, and fitted positive-inertia coefficients fall below the electrical energy conversion expected from the 314 kg minimum-mass prior; coefficients remain confounded with noisy differentiated speed and road terms.

vehicle.row_replay_scope: Observed Speed is forced; no acceleration term is predicted. 10 km segment coefficients from other days are applied to local road-load terms for each source timestamp.
limitations: The 10 km fit does not identify rolling resistance, CdA, mass, grade bias and motor efficiency independently.
Per-sample residual includes unmodeled acceleration, grade map error, wind/irradiance interpolation and telemetry quantization.
Day 6 is held out because of the logged ZP/retirement anomaly.

metric_definitions.load_proxy_w: Solar_Watt + Battery_Watt; signed battery power is positive discharge and negative charge.
metric_definitions.pv_prediction_scope: Weather-forced, cross-day fold model; parked/tilted posture is outside fit eligibility.
metric_definitions.battery_voltage_validation: One-minute medians on moving road samples with positive battery current; SoC itself has no ground truth.

calibration_statement: No user calibration adjustment was made. Model-fit gains and R values correct model structure only and are not sensor recalibration.

mpc_readiness_gate.criterion: Internal engineering gate: road-load OOF error must be below 25% of the predicted load change between adjacent ±2.5 km/h speed choices, so model error does not dominate the control choice. It is a decision-resolution criterion, not a BWSC regulation or published standard.
